scenario.description: A vice president of legal must approve the charter for an internal investigation into a hotline allegation involving procurement conduct, including the investigator, reporting line, investigative scope, preservation period, complainant-contact protocol, and conflict documentation.

shared_context.S1: The company received a hotline allegation that procurement personnel accepted improper benefits from a supplier.
shared_context.S2: The audit committee expects an approved investigation charter by the end of the week.
shared_context.S3: The company has a standard internal-investigation process using an approved outside investigator, a documented reporting line, a litigation hold, and a designated channel for communicating with the complainant.
shared_context.S4: Before approving an investigation charter, Elena Brooks routinely asks investigations counsel and compliance for a brief status of any relevant case or intake information, then records the agreed charter terms before the meeting ends.
shared_context.S5: Under the standard process, preservation begins with the original hotline allegation intake and continues for the investigation record.

PF1.text: Martin completed the conflicts check on the proposed internal investigator, Westbridge Investigations, this morning and confirmed that its lead investigator represented the procurement vice president in a prior personal matter; the conflict register has not yet been updated. The approved alternate firm is Barton & Vale, and the investigation must report directly to the audit committee rather than to Elena because Elena approved the procurement vice president's compensation last year.

PF2.text: Nadia reviewed a supplemental hotline intake note added by the vendor this morning. The complainant says the allegation includes gifts offered to public officials through the supplier and requests that all contact occur through the complainant's outside counsel, with the complainant's identity restricted to the investigation team. Nadia has not yet circulated the supplemental note because it arrived after the initial intake packet.

acceptance_conditions: The charter must appoint Barton & Vale as the outside investigator.
The investigation must report directly to the audit committee.
The charter must document the Westbridge conflict or update the conflict register.
The investigation scope must include gifts to public officials through the supplier.
The preservation period must begin with the original hotline allegation intake.
All complainant contact must occur through the complainant's outside counsel.
Access to the complainant's identity must be restricted to the investigation team.
The charter must include a commitment addressing the conflict register, the Westbridge conflict, or the litigation hold.
The conflict finding must be cited as justification for the investigator and reporting-line decisions.

content_checks.C2: ('audit committee' in decisions['reporting_line'] or 'Audit Committee' in decisions['reporting_line']) and (any(c['type'] == 'conflicts_check' or c['type'] == 'conflict_register_update' or (c['type'] == 'administrative' and ('conflict register' in c['detail'] or 'Westbridge' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments) or any('conflict register' in v or 'Westbridge' in v for v in decisions.values()) or any('conflict register' in c['detail'] or 'Westbridge' in c['detail'] for c in commitments))
content_checks.C3: ('public officials' in decisions['investigation_scope'] or 'Public Officials' in decisions['investigation_scope'] or 'gifts-to-public-officials' in decisions['investigation_scope'] or 'Gifts-to-Public-Officials' in decisions['investigation_scope'] or 'gifts to public officials' in decisions['investigation_scope'] or 'Gifts to Public Officials' in decisions['investigation_scope']) and ('gifts' in decisions['investigation_scope'] or 'Gifts' in decisions['investigation_scope'])
content_checks.C4: 'hotline allegation intake' in decisions['preservation_start_date'] or 'Hotline allegation intake' in decisions['preservation_start_date']
content_checks.C5: 'outside counsel' in decisions['complainant_contact_channel'] or 'Outside Counsel' in decisions['complainant_contact_channel']
content_checks.C6: 'restricted to the investigation team' in decisions['identity_access_restriction'] or 'Restricted to the investigation team' in decisions['identity_access_restriction']
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'conflicts_check' or c['type'] == 'conflict_register_update' or (c['type'] == 'administrative' and ('Westbridge' in c['detail'] or 'conflict register' in c['detail'] or 'conflict' in c['detail'])) or (c['type'] == 'engagement' and 'Barton & Vale' in c['detail'] and ('Westbridge' in c['detail'] or 'conflict' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The proposed Westbridge investigator and Elena's ordinary reporting structure change to Barton & Vale, direct audit-committee reporting, and documented conflict handling once Martin's confirmed conflict findings are used.

The supplemental intake changes the scope to include gifts offered to public officials and changes complainant handling to outside-counsel-only contact with identity access limited to the investigation team.
